## About
Long's Car Care Center is a local, family-owned shop in Woodinville, under the leadership of Randy Long. We treat every vehicle with the same care and attention we'd give our own.
We're Woodinville's only AAA-approved auto repair facility, and our ASE-certified technicians use high-quality OEM or equivalent parts and products.
We listen, keep detailed records of your vehicle's service history, and send maintenance reminders so you can stay ahead and stress less. When something needs fixing, we explain the problem, your repair options, and the costs before any work starts.

## Services
- Oil Changes: Routine oil changes, done right and on schedule.
- Electrical Diagnosis & Repair: Charging systems, alternators and other electrical problems tracked down and fixed.
- Brakes & ABS Diagnostics Service/Repair: Brake service and ABS diagnostics and repair.
- Suspension, Steering & Exhaust Repairs: Repairs to keep your car riding, steering and running the way it should.
- Emissions Repairs: Repairs to get your vehicle's emissions back in order.
- Preventative Maintenance: Staying ahead of problems to reduce the risk of unexpected breakdowns and costly repairs.
- Cooling/Air conditioning System Service: Service for your cooling and air conditioning systems.
- Regular Service Reminders: We keep your service history on file and remind you when maintenance is coming up.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 12:00 PM and 1:00 to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I drop my car off outside business hours?
A: Yes. Use our secure key drop box just outside the front door, and we'll get started first thing in the morning.

Q: Will I be surprised by the bill?
A: No. Our estimates are based on honest assessments, and we keep you informed throughout the repair.

Q: What kind of parts do you use?
A: We use high-quality OEM or equivalent parts and products.
